title: Paying Extra for Digital Services
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on objections to paying extra or ongoing subscriptions for digital, infotainment, and previously included features, with one example framing higher payment as worthwhile for comfort.

positive.summary: One positive review says paying more was acceptable because it delivered a comfortable drive.

negative.summary: Negative reviews object to extra charges, subscriptions, and having to repay for basic or previously included functions shortly after purchase.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention paying extra, subscriptions, expiring digital services, or standard equipment without enough context to confirm a clear overall sentiment in each case.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, which limits confidence in drawing a fuller sentiment picture from the examples.
The examples focus mainly on digital services, infotainment, subscriptions, and feature access, but some fragments are too brief to determine whether the reaction is clearly favorable or unfavorable.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of the full review population.
